summary: Add lifecycle-aware ordered memberships and explicit folder-only arrangement v2

replay.detail: Stores without ordered_membership_heads_v1 rebuild the new membership projections from unrepaired retained membership claims during synchronous store open, before the API becomes available. Existing v1 placements are not migrated. The checkpoint rules bump alone does not trigger a new full graph replay; existing graph recovery triggers remain unchanged. Arrangement or membership record repairs rebuild both dependent projections to retract repaired originals.

schema.detail: Adds raw membership heads, live keyset rows, counters, lifecycle dependencies and a local pending queue with indexes and lifecycle-maintenance triggers. Atomically upgrades the existing declared_resource_edges table/index to discriminate declared-resource and ordered-membership relations. Numeric database schema version is unchanged; reinstalling an older binary does not reverse this table migration.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules move from 13 to 14 to include raw/live memberships, counters and lifecycle dependencies in proof/replay, with no new membership drop rule. Shared projection compatibility uses st3.shared-projections.ordered-membership.v1. Coordinate member upgrades before sealing new checkpoints; mixed layouts continue exchanging claim authority but do not compare incompatible projection maps, and older schema registries do not admit the new claim kind as known authority.

compatibility.detail: Arrangements capability version 2 adds explicit folder-only v2 creation, a typed membership edit action, snapshot-bound keyset pages and bounded membership collection frames. V1 bodies/placements stay supported and concurrent v1/v2 creation preserves unrepaired v1 authority. Generated Rust collection events add typed membership variants; exhaustive consumers must handle them. TypeScript membership windows carry OrderedMembership rather than Resource rows. Reads/writes retain read.arrangements/control.arrangements scopes and real actors. Cross-version daemon/client pairs and native Swift execution have not been exercised.

downtime.detail: Opening an existing durable store synchronously migrates the reverse index and initializes membership projections. Restart-to-API and restart-to-health durations for deployed stores have not been measured; allow recovery time rather than relying on a fixed interruption estimate.

manual.detail: Upgrade participating members before creating v2 layouts or sealing rules-14 checkpoints. Existing v1 layouts require a separately scoped canonical-winner-preserving migration before using membership actions; this change supplies no automatic conversion and requires no manual change to v1 readers/writers. Preserve a pre-upgrade store backup and follow docs/st3/client-v0/README.md#ordered-memberships-and-new-version-2-layouts for capability discovery, explicit creation and typed membership operations.

recovery.detail: Membership projections rebuild from retained unrepaired claims; hidden and absent winners remain retained. A failed startup migration can be retried without erasing authority. Binary swap-back across the relation-aware reverse index, new claim vocabulary and rules-14 checkpoints is unverified; prefer rolling forward, or restore a consistent pre-upgrade store backup with the matching older binary rather than assuming reinstall undoes migrations.
